$comment: Kodukeel API v1 (ADR-029). Generated by `npm run api:schema` from lib/api/contract.ts and lib/api/draft.ts; do not edit. A route marked draft may still change. A response may gain fields within v1, so a client ignores fields it does not know.

body.description: Every refusal from a v1 route, whatever its status.

GET /api/v1/meta.summary: The API version, the oldest native build still answered, what is switched off, the speech model's pins and how to sign in.

response.description: What this installation is, for a native app before it signs in. Nothing about any person.

level.description: The level the course opens at, measured or stated.

dailyGoal.description: Reviews a day that fill the goal ring, 5 to 200.

glossLanguage.description: The language a meaning leads in beside the English.

voice.description: The voice that reads Estonian aloud, by id.

speechPace.description: A pace's id, or `auto` where it follows the level.

sendAtOnce.description: Whether a line the microphone matched is sent without the countdown.

inBoxes.description: Whether the microphone appears in answer boxes.

sceneAnswer.description: How a conversation is answered, or null where never chosen.

timeZone.description: An IANA zone name, or null where the device never said.

roundPace.description: How long a timed round runs, as a pace's id.

reminderAt.description: The evening reminder's time, `HH:MM`, or null where never set.

letters.description: Every kind of letter and notification a learner may switch, and whether it is on.

response.description: Who the token belongs to, and the settings a phone shows.

PATCH /api/v1/me.summary: Settings changed, each as its Settings control changes it; a level asks the A1 checks first.

level.description: Asked of the A1 checks first, as the web's level picker asks: a move up past an unpassed check is refused with `forbidden`.

dailyGoal.description: Clamped to 5 to 200, as the web clamps it.

voice.description: A voice id; one the server does not offer is stored as its default.

speechPace.description: A pace id, or `auto`; anything else is stored as `auto`.

timeZone.description: An IANA zone name; one the server cannot read refuses the whole change.

reminderAt.description: `HH:MM`; a malformed time is clamped to one, never refused.

letters.description: Kinds switched on or off; a kind the server does not send refuses the whole change.

request.description: Some of the settings a phone shows, each normalized as its Settings control normalizes it. Nothing is written unless every field can be.

roundPace.description: How long a timed round runs, as a pace's id.

DELETE /api/v1/me.summary: The account deleted, everything the app holds and the sign-in record where it can be.

confirmation.description: The word the learner typed: `delete`, or its Russian or Ukrainian, as Settings asks.

identityErased.description: Whether the sign-in record went too; false on a local install and where the operator holds no key that can.

remaining.description: What is left and who to ask, in English, or null where nothing is.

response.description: Everything is gone. Drop the session on the device at once: the access token verifies until it expires, and a request made with it in that hour writes as a new, empty learner, which nothing reads, reminds or exports. A failure partway answers `upstream` and deletes nothing.

GET /api/v1/export.summary: The learner's backup, the file the web's export downloads, under the same allowance.

response.description: The backup the web's export downloads, every table of the learner's own, which the web's restore reads back.

POST /api/v1/push-devices.summary: A phone registered for notifications; refused with `switched_off` where the operator has set none up.

token.description: The registration token Firebase Cloud Messaging gave the app on this phone. A registration past 1,024 characters is refused with `invalid`, since no token Firebase hands out is that long.

request.description: A phone to remind, registered on every launch so the server knows it was seen. The app build is read off `X-Kodukeel-Build`.

response.description: The phone will be reminded of the kinds its owner left switched on, on no second channel the same day.

DELETE /api/v1/push-devices.summary: A phone forgotten, so it is reminded of nothing more.

token.description: The registration token Firebase Cloud Messaging gave the app on this phone. A registration past 1,024 characters is refused with `invalid`, since no token Firebase hands out is that long.

request.description: A phone to stop reminding, sent when the learner turns notifications off or signs out.

forgotten.description: Whether this learner had that phone registered.

GET /api/v1/review.summary: Today's review sitting, as the web's review session receives it.

items.description: One run of a sentence, with the dictionary entry it was vouched as, if any.

intro.description: What to show the first time this word is met; null on a card already seen.

anyOf.description: A meaning as the learner's language leads it; the English is never dropped while an equivalent leads.

items.description: A meaning as the learner's language leads it; the English is never dropped while an equivalent leads.

scheduling.description: A card's scheduling, as a grade leaves it and as undo puts it back.

items.description: One card of a review sitting, as the web's review session receives it.

nextDue.description: When the next card comes back, on an empty sitting alone; the line is in the learner's language.

waitingOnCourse.description: Whether unseen cards are held back until the course reaches them.

response.description: Today's review sitting: due cards, then a capped trickle of new ones, held to what the course has taught.

POST /api/v1/grades.summary: One grade or a batch, idempotent by id, as the offline outbox replays them.

id.description: The id the device chose for this answer, before it asked. Sending it twice records it once.

reviewedAt.description: Epoch milliseconds on the device, clamped by the server to the last thirty days and to never after it heard.

slot.description: What the round asked about, where narrower than the card; checked against a closed list.

reachedSlot.description: The form that came back instead, where the round could name one.

spoken.description: True only where the answer marked is what the recognizer heard, word for word.

settled.description: Every id the client may now drop: recorded now, recorded before, or never recordable.

anyOf.description: A card's scheduling, as a grade leaves it and as undo puts it back.

scheduling.description: What this request left the card at, or null where it wrote nothing now.

results.description: One entry per grade written by this request, in the order they were applied.

POST /api/v1/grades/undo.summary: A card's scheduling put back; the review log is untouched.

previous.description: The scheduling the card had before the grade being taken back, as the grade's own answer gave it.

GET /api/v1/today.summary: Whether today is a lesson, a check, the web or nothing planned.

finished.description: True where today's lesson is already done; the next one waits for tomorrow.

final.description: Whether this is the check on the whole of the level.

passed.description: Whether the part after it is open; false until the check is passed.

href.description: The path of today on the web, under the deployment's own address.

response.description: Whether today is a lesson, a check, the web or nothing planned.

GET /api/v1/lessons/{id}.summary: One lesson, as the web's lesson screen receives it, with its English in the learner's language.

cast.description: Who speaks, by name, and the voice each is read in.

sounds.description: Recordings by id, as `GET /api/v1/recordings` names them.

examples.description: Lines of the conversation, by index.

lesson.description: One lesson as the web's lesson screen receives it. Two conventions run through its English, and a native screen draws them as the web's `Braced` does: Estonian inside an English sentence is written in braces, `{mina}`, and is marked as Estonian; a form's name in square brackets, `[osastav] (3rd form)`, is Estonian too and is not a word the lesson teaches. A capital I in a form's English hint is set in a face where it cannot be read as a lower-case l. The stand-in name Tom in a model answer is replaced by the learner's own `name` after translating. The Estonian was written for a beginner and read by a native speaker; a client draws it as it stands and never joins, respells or builds a line.

oneOf.description: The quick warm-up a lesson's practice opens on: words said alone, each to be matched to its English.
A line of a conversation with one word taken out; `before + answer + after` is the line again.
A question from a conversation, and what was said back, among the answers to other questions.

accept.description: Every spelling that counts, the asked one first.

items.description: One question, built on the server; the client never decides what a learner is asked.

oneOf.description: The quick warm-up a lesson's practice opens on: words said alone, each to be matched to its English.
A line of a conversation with one word taken out; `before + answer + after` is the line again.
A question from a conversation, and what was said back, among the answers to other questions.

accept.description: Every spelling that counts, the asked one first.

items.description: One question, built on the server; the client never decides what a learner is asked.

next.description: The next lesson in the same level, or null at its end and past a part's end until its check is passed.

scene.description: The lesson's own conversation, a scene id, where it has one.

name.description: The learner's own first name, for a model answer about them.

due.description: Cards due in the learner's reviews now.

check.description: The check that closes this lesson's part, where this is its last lesson.

part.description: The part this lesson is in, lesson by lesson, with the ones the learner has done.

nativePart.description: The one part of the conversation the native speaker recorded whole, which a phone plays in his voice by `GET /api/v1/recordings`; every other part keeps the cast's synthetic voice, as on the web (N-6).

translations.description: The lesson's own English in the learner's language, keyed by the English it replaces, for every line a translation exists for; empty in English. The Estonian is never in it and never changes.

response.description: One lesson, as the web's lesson screen receives it.

POST /api/v1/lessons/{id}/finish.summary: A finished lesson: today ticked where it is today's, and its words in the deck.

recorded.description: Whether today's evening was ticked; false for a lesson ahead of today, which records nothing.

GET /api/v1/checks/{id}.summary: One attempt's paper at a part's check.

items.description: The attempt's questions as the web's check screen receives them, the right answers included, which the web uses for feedback too; the mark is the server's.

oneOf.description: The quick warm-up a lesson's practice opens on: words said alone, each to be matched to its English.
A line of a conversation with one word taken out; `before + answer + after` is the line again.
A question from a conversation, and what was said back, among the answers to other questions.

accept.description: Every spelling that counts, the asked one first.

items.description: One question, built on the server; the client never decides what a learner is asked.

needed.description: How many marks a pass takes.

next.description: The part a pass opens: its id, and what the web's check calls it, a lesson part by its name, a new level by its level, a part taught as units by its id; in the learner's language.

levelDone.description: Set on the last check of a level: what the level was and what is next, in the learner's language, as the web's check says it after a pass.

arrival.description: What somebody can now do, one sentence.

lessons.description: Whether the next level is taught as lessons.

response.description: One attempt's paper at a part's check.

POST /api/v1/checks/{id}.summary: An attempt marked on the server, and a pass recorded.

attempt.description: The attempt the paper was fetched for; the server builds that paper again to mark it.

responses.description: What was picked or typed for each question, in order; null where nothing was.

response.description: The attempt marked on the server. A right answer is one point and a nearly half.

POST /api/v1/scenes.summary: A conversation opened, from the situations list or a lesson's own role-play.

sceneId.description: A scene from the situations list, or a lesson's own role-play, which `GET /api/v1/lessons/{id}` names as `scene`.

difficulty.description: How many things go wrong on the other side, from none to most.

level.description: The band the other side talks at; the learner's own level where absent.

you.description: Who the learner is in this scene, in English.

returned.description: Dealt because the learner reached for this word in a recent scene and did not have it.

given.description: What the card dealt, in English; the learner says it in Estonian.

persona.description: Who is on the other side, as the learner is introduced to them.

plays.description: How many times this learner has had this conversation before.

composed.description: Whether a model writes the other side's lines in this run; false is the built-in lines throughout.

response.description: A conversation opened: the briefing a person walking in would have, and nothing about what is going to happen.

POST /api/v1/scenes/{runId}/turns.summary: One turn taken: every turn so far sent, the newest marked, and the other side's answer.

beatId.description: The `beatId` the answer before this turn named.

said.description: What the learner sent, typed or said; the server reads at most 300 characters.

helped.description: Whether the help button handed over a word for this turn.

picked.description: Picked from the offered lines rather than typed, which grades nothing.

heard.description: The other side's Estonian line this turn answers; never what a recognizer heard.

conceded.description: Echoed from the answer that conceded them.

alsoDone.description: Echoed from the answer that named them.

repairs.description: Only the repaired words, never what the recognizer heard; a repaired word earns no grade.

to.description: The word the dictionary read a heard word as, which went into the box.

wordsHeard.description: How many words the recognizer heard.

wordsChanged.description: How many of them the learner changed before sending.

unseen.description: True only where the line this turn answered was hidden on screen behind a press the learner did not press, so the turn was answered by ear. It is the evidence that somebody can follow spoken Estonian, so a client sends true only where it really hid the line; anything but an exact true reads as the line was shown.

spoken.description: A turn said aloud: its repaired words and its two counts, never the words heard.

items.description: One of the learner's turns, as the client keeps it and sends it back with every later one.

turns.description: Every turn so far, the newest last; empty for the other side's opening line.

used.description: The other side's lines said so far, so a line is not said twice.

provenance.description: Where the line came from. `unspoken`, `meanwhile` and `coach` are English from the app rather than the other side.

reaction.description: A reaction to the learner's turn rather than the line they now answer.

tokens.description: The dictionary under the line, where the learner asked for it.

items.description: One run of a sentence, with the dictionary entry it was vouched as, if any.

lines.description: What the other side says now, in order.

beatId.description: The beat the next turn answers; send it back as that turn's `beatId`.

goal.description: What the learner is trying to do now, in English.

items.description: What a turn was understood despite.

conceded.description: Write these onto the last turn sent, and send them back.

alsoDone.description: Write these onto the last turn sent, and send them back.

chosen.description: Card values the learner changed by saying another.

picks.description: Lines the learner may pick instead of typing.

hurdle.description: The curveball standing now, if one is.

composer.description: Who will write the other side's lines, where a model will.

composedBy.description: The model that wrote this turn's line.

modelDown.description: Every model link failed, so the other side speaks from prepared lines.

response.description: One turn answered: what the other side says, and where the conversation now is.

walkedOut.description: True where the learner left before the conversation was over.

asked.description: The words the help button handed over.

recap.description: The debrief's own summary, in the learner's language; it gives no grade.

gaps.description: Words the conversation needed and the learner did not have.

POST /api/v1/chat.summary: Today's chat opened, only where a model is configured; its turns go to the scene routes.

level.description: The band the other side talks at; the learner's own level where absent.

you.description: Who the learner is in this scene, in English.

returned.description: Dealt because the learner reached for this word in a recent scene and did not have it.

given.description: What the card dealt, in English; the learner says it in Estonian.

GET /api/v1/dictionary.summary: A dictionary search, the forms list and Ekilex asked as the web's dictionary asks them.

q.description: What was typed: a headword, an inflected form, or English.

matchedAs.description: Set where the query was an inflected form rather than the headword, the form named the way a class names it.

hits.description: The entries found, the likeliest first; `GET /api/v1/words/{id}` opens one.

knownAs.description: Where nothing matched directly, the headwords the spelling typed is a form of, the likeliest first.

fetched.description: Whether the dictionary asked Ekilex live to answer this search.

response.description: A dictionary search, as the web's dictionary page runs it.

GET /api/v1/words/{id}.summary: One dictionary entry, as the web's entry screen reads it.

translationRu.description: The Institute's own Russian, where Ekilex recorded one; never a model's.

translationUk.description: The Institute's own Ukrainian, where Ekilex recorded one; never a model's.

ekilexWordId.description: The Ekilex word this entry was read from, or null where Ekilex supplied none of it. Where it is set, the entry carries the credit CC BY 4.0 asks for, as the web draws it: forms and example sentences from Ekilex (https://ekilex.ee), by the Institute of the Estonian Language, under CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), and any form shown as worked out was derived from what Ekilex stores.

et.description: The Estonian sentence, exactly as recorded.

en.description: Its English, where the dictionary holds one.

enRefused.description: A reviewer read the English and said it was wrong; none is offered.

examples.description: Recorded sentences, the one a beginner reads most easily first. A refused sentence never arrives.

forms.description: The forms the dictionary stores; the rest are worked out on the device from these, as the web does.

response.description: One dictionary entry, as the web's entry screen reads it. Nothing in it was written by a model.

POST /api/v1/deck.summary: A word kept, starred or put aside.

types.description: Which cards to build; a word builds only the ones it can support. The three the dictionary ticks by default.

context.description: Where the word was when it was put aside, for the reading the operator sees.

added.description: Cards built by a keep; 0 otherwise, and 0 where the word was already in the deck.

starred.description: Whether the word is starred now, after a star or an unstar; null otherwise.

note.description: The English sentence saying how long the word is away.

aside.description: How long a word put aside is away for; null otherwise. Nothing is graded.

response.description: A word kept, starred, put aside or brought back.

DELETE /api/v1/deck.summary: A star taken off, or a word put aside brought back.

action.description: `star` takes the star off; `aside` brings a word put aside back.

added.description: Cards built by a keep; 0 otherwise, and 0 where the word was already in the deck.

starred.description: Whether the word is starred now, after a star or an unstar; null otherwise.

note.description: The English sentence saying how long the word is away.

aside.description: How long a word put aside is away for; null otherwise. Nothing is graded.

response.description: A word kept, starred, put aside or brought back.

POST /api/v1/tts.summary: A clip read aloud, from the same store and under the same allowance as the web's.

text.description: What to read aloud, finished into a sentence on the server.

voice.description: One of the voices Settings offers; any other value is the deployment's own.

transient.description: A read-back of what the recognizer heard: never cached, never stored, and refused while speaking is switched off.

POST /api/v1/speech/forms.summary: Which heard words are Estonian spellings.

words.description: The words heard, and nothing else; at most sixty are asked, each up to forty letters.

known.description: Those of `asked` that are Estonian spellings.

asked.description: The words asked about, lowercased and deduplicated.

response.description: Which words just heard are Estonian spellings at all.

GET /api/v1/recordings.summary: The native speaker's clips and the spelling each answers for.

text.description: What is said, as it is written; for a letter, the letter.

src.description: Where the clip is served, under this site.

key.description: The spelling a speaker button finds this clip by, folded as `utteranceKey` folds it, or null where the clip is played by id alone: a sound, a letter's name, and a spelling that hides two words.

slow.description: A take said slowly on purpose; a speaker asked to play slowly takes it before the take at speed.

atOwnSpeed.description: Played at the speed it was said: by id always, and a slow take asked for slowly. Found by `key` at the learner's everyday pace, the player slows it as it slows a synthetic clip.

response.description: The native speaker's recordings, and which spelling each one answers for.

POST /api/v1/tutor.summary: A question to Anu, answered as a stream of text, with the model that answered in `x-model-provider` and `x-model-id`.

messages.description: The conversation so far, the question last. The newest turns that fit are what Anu reads.

screen.description: What was on the learner's screen when they asked, read as material and never as an instruction; never stored.

POST /api/v1/scan.summary: A photograph read: a page's words, or the things in it, vouched for by the dictionary. The photograph is never kept.

image.description: The photograph as a data URL; read once and never stored.

mode.description: A page of words, or the things around the learner named in Estonian.

et.description: The Estonian exactly as it was read off the page.

en.description: The gloss printed on the page, or empty.

lexemeId.description: The dictionary entry that vouches for this word, or null where none did: a guess for the person holding the paper to confirm.

response.description: A page read into words the dictionary vouched for or did not, or the things in a picture named. The model that read it is named in `x-model-provider` and `x-model-id`.

POST /api/v1/scans.summary: A page kept with the words the learner ticked, and their cards where asked.

lexemeId.description: The dictionary entry that vouches for this word, or null where none did: a guess for the person holding the paper to confirm.

items.description: The words ticked, as `POST /api/v1/scan` read them or as the learner corrected them; every one is vouched for again here.

addCards.description: Whether to build cards now, or just keep the page.

id.description: The kept page, which `POST /api/v1/scans/{id}/deck` adds to the deck later.

created.description: Words the dictionary did not hold, kept as the learner's own entries.

response.description: A page kept: the words ticked, never the photograph.

POST /api/v1/scans/{id}/deck.summary: Every word on a kept page that is not in the deck yet, added.

response.description: Every word on a kept page that was not in the deck, added.
